title: sample~

messages.description: size in samples, sample rate, size in ms, channels and bit depth

arguments.description: file to load, followed by the same optional values as the 'open' message

flags.name: -size <float>
flags.description: sets maximum buffer size in ms (default 1000)

flags.name: -ch <float>
flags.description: sets number of channels (default 1, or the file's)

flags.name: -sr <float>
flags.description: sets sample rate to save to (default Pd's)

flags.name: -depth <float>
flags.description: sets bit depth to save to (default 16)

methods.description: opens a file, optionally followed by number of channels, size in ms and offset in ms; no file name opens a dialog box
outputs size, sample rate, channels and bit depth
trims to a range in ms
saves to a file, no symbol opens a dialog box
sets the sample rate to save the file with
sets bit depth to save with: 8, 16, 24, 32 or 64

body: [sample~] is an abstraction that creates an audio buffer which you can use to load a sample or record into. It can load and save multichannel files.
